*Read-only.*

Read the routing fields of a USoundSourceBus asset: source_bus_channels (Mono or Stereo), duration in seconds (0 plays indefinitely) and the UAudioBus it outputs to (audio_bus_path and audio_bus_class, empty when none). Read-only. Writer: set_sound_source_bus_audio_bus.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ssb_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USoundSourceBus, e.g. "/Game/Audio/SSB_Radio". |

**Returns:** `{ ssb_path: string, asset_class: string, source_bus_channels: string, duration: float, audio_bus_path: string, audio_bus_class: string }`

## `get_sound_wave_properties`

*Read-only.*

Read every reflected property of a USoundWave asset, its USoundBase fields included (CompressionQuality, SampleRateQuality, SoundGroup, Volume, Pitch, Priority, SoundClassObject, AttenuationSettings and the rest), as the settings object FJsonObjectConverter exports, so keys start lower-case (compressionQuality); settings also carries bLooping, echoed as looping. Like inspect_object on the asset, but keyed as set_sound_wave_properties accepts it; get_properties reads a few named fields. Read-only: it loads the asset if needed and changes nothing. A path that does not load as a USoundWave is an error. Write the same fields back with set_sound_wave_properties (bLooping through its looping param); a sound class is read with get_sound_class_properties and a level's audio component with get_audio_component_properties.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound_wave_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundWave, e.g. "/Game/Audio/MySound". |

**Returns:** `{ sound_wave_path: string, asset_class: string, settings: object, looping: bool }`

## `get_soundfield_submix_info`

*Read-only.*

Read a USoundfieldSubmix asset without changing it: its soundfield_encoding_format and resolved_format, encoding_settings {class, path}, and effect_chain entries {index, class, path, settings_class, settings_path} with chain_length. Adds a note when no concrete soundfield effect class is loaded.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `submix_path` | string | yes | Full path to the USoundfieldSubmix (required). |

**Returns:** `{ submix_path, soundfield_encoding_format, resolved_format, encoding_settings_class, encoding_settings: { class, path }, effect_chain: [{ index, class, path, settings_class, settings_path }], chain_length, note? }`

## `get_submix_effect_chain`

*Read-only.*

Read the effect chain of a USoundSubmix asset in order: one entry per slot with the name, class and path of its USoundEffectSubmixPreset ("None" for an empty slot), plus chain_length. Read-only; add_submix_effect_to_chain appends to it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `submix_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USoundSubmix, e.g. "/Game/Audio/SM_Master.SM_Master". |

**Returns:** `{ submix_path: string, effects: [object], chain_length: int }`

## `list_metasound_node_types`

*Read-only.*

Enumerate all MetaSound node classes registered with the engine (via Metasound::Frontend::ISearchEngine). Editor-only because ISearchEngine::FindAllClasses is gated by WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_unloaded` | boolean | no | If true (default), include classes from assets not yet loaded into memory. |

**Returns:** `{ count, types: [{ class_name, class_path, type, version, is_native }] }`

## `list_metasound_nodes`

*Read-only.*

List every node in the default graph of a MetaSound Source asset with its GUID id, name, class name and input/output counts, plus count. Read-only; pass the id to get_metasound_node_info and the other node tools.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | MetaSound Source asset path, e.g. "/Game/Audio/MS_Rain"; MetaSound Patches are not accepted. |

**Returns:** `{ metasound_path, count, nodes: [{ id, name, class_name, input_count, output_count }] }`

## `list_subtitle_cues`

*Read-only.*

Lists all subtitle cues on a USubtitleAssetUserData.  Read-only walk of the Subtitles array, returning cue_count, max_duration (from USubtitleAssetUserData::GetMaximumDuration), and per-cue fields (index, text, start_offset, duration, duration_type, priority, subtitle_type, comment).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Content path of the USubtitleAssetUserData asset. |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, success: bool, count: int, max_duration: float, cues: [{index, text, start_offset, duration, duration_type, priority, subtitle_type, comment}] }`

## `play_sound`

*Additive.*

Starts the sound already assigned to an audio component of the editor world, matched by object name (case-insensitive) against the first audio component of each actor; components in a running PIE world are not reached. start_time is an offset in seconds into the sound. A component without a sound is an error: assign one with set_audio_sound. Transient: nothing is saved, marked dirty or undoable. was_playing and playing are read just before and just after the call. Stop with stop_sound; to play an asset at a location without a component use play_sound_at_location.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio_component_name` | string | yes | Name of the audio component to play sound on |
| `start_time` | number | no | Optional offset in seconds to start playback at |

**Returns:** `{ audio_component_name: string, playing: bool, was_playing: bool, sound_name: string, start_time: number, success: bool }`

## `play_sound_at_location`

*Destructive.*

Plays a sound asset at a specific world location without requiring an audio component.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound_path` | string | yes | Full asset path to the sound (e.g. '/Game/Audio/MySound.MySound') |
| `location` | array | yes | [x, y, z] 3D location to play the sound at |
| `volume` | number | no | Optional volume multiplier; defaults to 1.0 |
| `pitch` | number | no | Optional pitch multiplier; defaults to 1.0 |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] rotation of the sound (it matters to a directional attenuation) |

**Returns:** `{ sound_path: string, sound_name: string, location: { x, y, z }, rotation: { pitch, yaw, roll }, volume: number, pitch: number, success: bool }`

## `remove_bus_from_mix`

*Destructive.*

Removes every stage that uses a USoundControlBus from a USoundControlBusMix asset and saves the mix; a removal succeeds only when the mix reaches disk. A bus that is not in the mix is already the state asked for: the call succeeds with removed false and already_absent true, and saves nothing. Returns mix_path, bus_path, removed, already_absent, stage_count, saved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mix_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundControlBusMix |
| `bus_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundControlBus to remove from the mix |

**Returns:** `{ mix_path, bus_path, removed, already_absent, stage_count, saved }`

## `remove_metasound_graph_input`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Removes a graph INPUT (and its node) from a MetaSound Source by name (inverse of add_metasound_graph_input).  Queries GetGraphInputNames first: if the input is already absent it returns already_absent without error (idempotent), otherwise it calls UMetaSoundBuilderBase::RemoveGraphInput and reports the result. Saves the asset.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the MetaSound Source. |
| `input_name` | string | yes | Name of the graph input to remove. |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, input_name: string, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool, save_error: string?, note: string? }`

## `remove_metasound_graph_output`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Removes a graph OUTPUT (and its node) from a MetaSound Source by name (inverse of add_metasound_graph_output).  Queries GetGraphOutputNames first: if the output is already absent it returns already_absent without error (idempotent), otherwise it calls UMetaSoundBuilderBase::RemoveGraphOutput and reports the result. Saves the asset.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the MetaSound Source. |
| `output_name` | string | yes | Name of the graph output to remove. |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, output_name: string, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool, save_error: string?, note: string? }`

## `remove_metasound_node`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Removes a node from a MetaSound Source graph by its node_id GUID (inverse of add_metasound_node).  Parses the node_id into a node handle and queries ContainsNode first: if the node is already absent it returns already_absent without error (idempotent), otherwise it calls UMetaSoundBuilderBase::RemoveNode (pruning unused dependencies) and reports the result. Saves the asset.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the MetaSound Source. |
| `node_id` | string | yes | GUID of the node to remove (from add_metasound_node). |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, node_id: string, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool, save_error: string?, note: string? }`

## `remove_modulation_input_from_patch`

*Destructive.*

Removes every input of a USoundModulationPatch asset whose bus has the same asset name as bus_path, then saves the patch; a removal succeeds only when the patch reaches disk. When no input matches, the patch is already the state asked for: the call succeeds with removed false and already_removed true, and saves nothing. Returns patch_path, bus_path, removed, already_removed, input_count, saved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patch_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundModulationPatch |
| `bus_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundControlBus whose input is removed |

**Returns:** `{ patch_path, bus_path, removed, already_removed, input_count, saved }`

## `remove_soundfield_effect`

*Destructive.*

Detach the effect at effect_index from a USoundfieldSubmix effect chain (undoable) and save; the effect object stays in the package, an out-of-range index is an error, and a removal succeeds only when the submix reaches disk. Returns removed_effect_class, removed_effect_path and chain_length. With no concrete effect class loaded nothing changes and the call fails, with removed false and a note.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `submix_path` | string | yes | Full path to the USoundfieldSubmix (required). |
| `effect_index` | number | yes | Zero-based index into SoundfieldEffectChain (required). |

**Returns:** `{ submix_path, effect_index, removed_effect_class, removed_effect_path, removed: true, already_absent: false, chain_length, saved, save_error? } -- success only when saved; with no concrete effect class loaded the call fails with { submix_path, effect_index, removed: false, saved: false, note } and the chain is not touched.`

## `remove_subtitle_cue`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove a single FSubtitleAssetData cue by index. Inverse of add_subtitle_cue; use delete_asset to destroy the whole asset instead. Idempotent: an out-of-range index returns removed:false + note, not an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_path` | string | yes | /Game path to the USubtitleAssetUserData. |
| `cue_index` | number | yes | 0-based index into Subtitles[]. |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path, cue_index, removed, previous_count, new_count }`

## `set_audio_bus_channels`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Change the channel layout (AudioBusChannels) of an existing UAudioBus asset and save it; success requires the save. Returns channels, channels_int and num_channels read back from the asset. To make a new bus use create_audio_bus.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bus_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the UAudioBus, e.g. "/Game/Audio/AB_Music". |
| `channels` | string | yes | EAudioBusChannels: 'Mono' \| 'Stereo' \| 'Quad' \| 'FiveDotOne' \| 'SevenDotOne', case-insensitive; FivePointOne, 5.1, SevenPointOne and 7.1 are accepted too. |

**Returns:** `{ bus_path: string, asset_class: string, channels: string, channels_int: int, num_channels: int, saved: bool }`

## `set_audio_sound`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets the sound asset of an audio component of the editor world, matched by object name (case-insensitive) against the first audio component of each actor; components in a running PIE world are not reached. A component that is playing restarts with the new sound unless it allows multiple instances. The change is not saved, marked dirty or undoable. A missing component or a sound that does not load is an error. previous_sound_name names the sound it replaced (None when there was none). Start playback with play_sound.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio_component_name` | string | yes | Name of the audio component to modify |
| `sound_path` | string | yes | Full asset path to the sound (e.g. '/Game/Audio/MySound.MySound') |

**Returns:** `{ audio_component_name: string, sound_path: string, sound_name: string, previous_sound_name: string, sound_duration: number, success: bool }`

## `set_audio_volume`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set VolumeMultiplier (0 to 10, else an error; also resets VolumeModulationMin/Max to 1) on an audio component of the editor world, matched by object name against the first audio component of each actor. No undo, no dirty mark. Returns old_volume, new_volume and volume_set.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio_component_name` | string | yes | Object name of the audio component to modify (e.g. "AudioComponent0"), compared without case; only the first audio component of each actor is searched. |
| `volume` | number | yes | Volume multiplier between 0.0 and 10.0 |

**Returns:** `{ audio_component_name: string, old_volume: number, new_volume: number, requested_volume: number, volume_set: bool, volume_message: string, audio_enabled: bool, audio_pitch: number, audio_mobility: string, audio_sound_name: string, audio_3d_attenuation_radius: number, audio_position: { x, y, z }, audio_owner_name: string }`

## `set_control_bus_mix_stage_value`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets the stored target value, and optionally the attack and release fade times in seconds, of the stage a USoundControlBus has in a USoundControlBusMix asset, then saves the mix; success requires the save. Only that bus's first stage is edited, inside an undo transaction; a bus that is not in the mix is an error (add it with add_bus_to_mix). It edits the asset, not a live value: push a runtime value with set_control_bus_value. Read the stages with get_control_bus_mix_info.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mix_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundControlBusMix |
| `bus_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundControlBus whose stage is edited |
| `target_value` | number | yes | New stage target value (required float) |
| `attack_time` | number | no | Optional attack interpolation time in seconds |
| `release_time` | number | no | Optional release interpolation time in seconds |

**Returns:** `{ mix_path, bus_path, target_value, attack_time, release_time, updated, saved }`

## `set_control_bus_value`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Pushes a runtime value into a USoundControlBus through a global bus mix of the editor world (UAudioModulationStatics::SetGlobalBusMixValue), fading over fade_time. Transient: the asset is not modified or saved, and applied is always true, not read back; read the live value with get_control_bus_info.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bus_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundControlBus |
| `value` | number | yes | New runtime bus value to push (required float) |
| `fade_time` | number | no | Fade time in seconds; a negative value reuses the last fade time of the global stage, or 0.1 s if none was set (default -1.0) |

**Returns:** `{ bus_path, value, fade_time, applied }`

## `set_metasound_graph_input_default`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the default value of one graph input of a MetaSound Source asset (a preset included) through the MetaSound editor builder, in one undo step, then save the asset. Give one typed field: bool_value (true or false), int_value (a whole number), string_value (a string) or value (a number, read as a float); with several, the first in that order wins. Or give parameter_type (float, int, bool or string) and value in that JSON type, the typed fields then being ignored. A missing or mistyped value, an unknown parameter_type, an unknown source, or an input that is missing or does not take that type is an error, with nothing written. value_set means the default reads back as the value; an input already holding it gives changed=false and saved=false, nothing written. A failed save makes success false with save_error. Inputs and their defaults: get_metasound_info (include_defaults); a node pin: set_metasound_node_input_default.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the MetaSound Source. |
| `input_name` | string | yes | Name of the graph input whose default to set. |
| `preset_path` | string | no | Alias of metasound_path. |
| `parameter_name` | string | no | Alias of input_name. |
| `parameter_type` | string | no | Optional literal type of value: "float", "int", "bool" or "string". When given, value must be of that JSON type (a whole number for int) and int_value/bool_value/string_value are ignored; another type name is an error. |
| `value` | any | no | Float default value, a JSON number (optional, used if no other *_value is provided); with parameter_type, the value in the JSON type it names. Another JSON type is an error |
| `int_value` | number | no | Int32 default value, a whole JSON number (optional, mutually exclusive with value/bool_value/string_value) |
| `bool_value` | boolean | no | Bool default value, JSON true or false (optional, mutually exclusive with value/int_value/string_value) |
| `string_value` | string | no | String default value, a JSON string (optional, mutually exclusive with value/int_value/bool_value) |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, input_name: string, value_type: string, value_set: bool, changed: bool, verified: bool, value_read_back: string, saved: bool, save_error?: string, note?: string }`

## `set_metasound_node_input_default`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the default literal of a named input pin on a concrete node of a MetaSound Source (node by node_id from add_metasound_node) through the MetaSound editor builder, then read it back and save the asset. Give one typed field: bool_value (true or false), int_value (a whole number), string_value (a string) or value (a number, read as a float); with several, the first in that order wins. A missing or mistyped value, an unknown source, node_id or pin, or a literal the pin refuses is an error. A failed save makes success false. For a graph input use set_metasound_graph_input_default.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the MetaSound Source. |
| `node_id` | string | yes | GUID of the node (from add_metasound_node). |
| `input_name` | string | yes | Name of the node input pin (discover via the node's enumerated inputs). |
| `value` | number | no | Float default, a JSON number (optional, used if no other *_value is provided). |
| `int_value` | number | no | Int32 default, a whole JSON number (optional, mutually exclusive). |
| `bool_value` | boolean | no | Bool default, JSON true or false (optional, mutually exclusive). |
| `string_value` | string | no | String default, a JSON string (optional, mutually exclusive). |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, node_id: string, input_name: string, value_type: string, value_set: bool, verified: bool, value_read_back: string, saved: bool }`

## `set_metasound_node_property`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Write one field of a MetaSound Source node's Configuration struct, node found by GUID, by reflection directly in the frontend document (not through the MetaSound builder), then save the asset. set_properties cannot reach it: frontend nodes are document data, not UObjects. No undo step. Re-applying a value returns value_changed false but still saves. Succeeds only when the asset reaches disk; a failed save leaves the value in memory only (saved false, save_error). Read: get_metasound_node_property; GUIDs: list_metasound_nodes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metasound_path` | string | yes | MetaSound Source asset path, e.g. "/Game/Audio/MS_Rain"; MetaSound Patches are not accepted. |
| `node_id` | string | yes | Node GUID, as list_metasound_nodes returns it in id; a value that is not a GUID is refused. |
| `property` | string | yes | FProperty name on the Configuration struct. |
| `value` | any | yes | New value for the field as JSON, converted by FJsonObjectConverter: a number, bool, string, array or object (for a struct field); numbers and booleans can also be passed as strings ("0.5", "true"). |

**Returns:** `{ metasound_path, node_id, property, set, value_changed, new_value?, saved, save_error? }`

## `set_modulation_generator_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Writes the settings that match the class of a USoundModulationGenerator asset (LFO, ADEnvelope or EnvelopeFollower) and saves it; params of another class are ignored and other generator classes are refused. The LFO shape (waveform) is set with create_modulation_generator. Returns generator_path, generator_class, settings as stored, updated, saved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `generator_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundModulationGenerator |
| `frequency` | number | no | LFO only: oscillation frequency in Hz (optional float) |
| `amplitude` | number | no | LFO only: output amplitude/gain multiplier (optional float) |
| `offset` | number | no | LFO only: output offset added to the waveform (optional float) |
| `phase` | number | no | LFO only: starting phase in degrees (optional float) |
| `attack_time` | number | no | ADEnvelope/EnvelopeFollower: attack interpolation time in seconds (optional float) |
| `decay_time` | number | no | ADEnvelope only: decay interpolation time in seconds (optional float) |
| `release_time` | number | no | EnvelopeFollower only: release interpolation time in seconds (optional float) |
| `gain` | number | no | EnvelopeFollower only: input gain applied before envelope detection (optional float) |
| `audio_bus_path` | string | no | EnvelopeFollower only: asset path to the UAudioBus the follower listens to (optional string) |

**Returns:** `{ generator_path, generator_class, settings: {...}, updated, saved }`

## `set_modulation_parameter_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Writes the given Settings fields (value_normalized, clamp_to_normalized_range, value_unit) of a USoundModulationParameter asset and saves it; omitted fields keep their value, and the asset is saved even when none is given. Returns parameter_path, the three settings as stored, updated, saved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parameter_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundModulationParameter |
| `value_normalized` | number | no | Optional float in [0,1]; sets Settings.ValueNormalized |
| `clamp_to_normalized_range` | boolean | no | Optional bool; sets Settings.bClampToNormalizedRange. Needs UE 5.8. |
| `value_unit` | number | no | Optional float (editor-only); sets Settings.ValueUnit |

**Returns:** `{ parameter_path, value_normalized, clamp_to_normalized_range, value_unit, updated, saved }`

## `set_modulation_patch_bypass`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets the bBypass flag of a USoundModulationPatch asset and saves it. A bypassed patch stays active but outputs the default value of its output parameter; new patches start bypassed. Returns patch_path, bBypass as stored, updated, saved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patch_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundModulationPatch |
| `bypass` | boolean | yes | New bypass value (required bool) |

**Returns:** `{ patch_path, bBypass, updated, saved }`

## `set_modulation_patch_output_parameter`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets the output USoundModulationParameter of a USoundModulationPatch asset, or clears it when parameter_path is an empty string, and saves the patch. Returns patch_path, parameter_path and parameter_class as stored (empty after a clear), updated, cleared, saved. Create a parameter with create_modulation_parameter.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patch_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundModulationPatch |
| `parameter_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the USoundModulationParameter (or empty string to clear) |

**Returns:** `{ patch_path, parameter_path, parameter_class, updated, cleared, saved }`

## `set_sound_attenuation_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Merge fields into a SoundAttenuation asset's Attenuation settings (absent keys kept), clamp to ClampMin/ClampMax and save; set_properties neither clamps nor saves. Keys match field names case-insensitively. An empty settings object, a key that names no field (the error lists them), a null value, or a value that is not of the field's kind or does not convert is an error and nothing changes. Plugin sub-objects are not reached. A failed save makes success false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attenuation_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundAttenuation. |
| `settings` | object | yes | Object of FSoundAttenuationSettings/FBaseAttenuationSettings fields to merge; absent keys untouched. e.g. bAttenuate, bSpatialize, attenuationShape(Sphere/Capsule/Box/Cone), distanceAlgorithm, falloffDistance, dBAttenuationAtMax(-60..0), attenuationShapeExtents{x,y,z}, bAttenuateWithLPF, lPFFrequencyAtMin/Max, bEnableOcclusion, occlusionVolumeAttenuation, bEnableReverbSend, reverbWetLevelMin/Max. Nested plugin sub-objects (pluginSettings, audioLinkSettingsOverride) are NOT authored here. Keys match the field names case-insensitively; an empty object, a key that names no field, a null value or a value that does not convert is an error and nothing is changed. |

**Returns:** `{ attenuation_path: string, asset_class: string, settings: object, applied_keys: [string], saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_class_parent`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Make one USoundClass the child of another, wiring ParentClass and ChildClasses, and save both packages. A previous parent loses the child in memory but is not saved; only self-parenting is refused, not cycles. Returns child_count, saved_parent and saved_child, succeeding even when a save fails.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `child_sound_class_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USoundClass to re-parent, e.g. "/Game/Audio/SC_Footsteps.SC_Footsteps". |
| `parent_sound_class_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USoundClass that becomes its parent, e.g. "/Game/Audio/SC_SFX.SC_SFX". |

**Returns:** `{ child: string, parent: string, child_path: string, parent_path: string, child_count: int, saved_parent: bool, saved_child: bool }`

## `set_sound_class_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Write the given FSoundClassProperties fields of a SoundClass asset (volume, pitch, filters, routing and loading flags) as flat named params, then save it. Use it over set_properties, which would need the nested Properties struct and leaves it unsaved; the parent link is set_sound_class_parent. Only fields you pass change; values are not range-checked and an unknown output_target or loading_behavior name is skipped (applied_&lt;field> false). Returns every current value plus saved; get_sound_class_properties reads them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound_class_path` | string | yes | Content path of the USoundClass asset. |
| `volume` | number | no | Volume multiplier for sounds of this class (Properties.Volume), e.g. 0.5 for half |
| `pitch` | number | no | Pitch multiplier for sounds of this class (Properties.Pitch), e.g. 1.2 |
| `low_pass_frequency` | number | no | Low-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz (Properties.LowPassFilterFrequency) |
| `attenuation_distance_scale` | number | no | Scale on the distance used for attenuation (Properties.AttenuationDistanceScale): 0.5 attenuates a sound 1000 units away as if it were 500 away |
| `lfe_bleed` | number | no | Amount of the sound sent to the LFE (subwoofer) channel (Properties.LFEBleed) |
| `voice_center_channel_volume` | number | no | Amount sent to the center channel (Properties.VoiceCenterChannelVolume); does not propagate to child classes |
| `radio_filter_volume` | number | no | Volume of the legacy radio filter effect (Properties.RadioFilterVolume) |
| `radio_filter_volume_threshold` | number | no | Volume at which the legacy radio filter kicks in (Properties.RadioFilterVolumeThreshold) |
| `default_2d_reverb_send_amount` | number | no | Reverb send amount for unattenuated (2D) sounds of this class (Properties.Default2DReverbSendAmount) |
| `apply_effects` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bApplyEffects (Output to Master EQ Submix): route referencing sounds to the Master EQ submix |
| `always_play` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bAlwaysPlay: inflate the priority of referencing sounds so they always play |
| `is_ui_sound` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bIsUISound: sounds of this class keep playing while the game is paused in the UI |
| `is_music` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bIsMusic: mark the class as music (propagates to child classes only when the parent is true) |
| `center_channel_only` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bCenterChannelOnly: force sounds of this class to the center channel |
| `apply_ambient_volumes` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bApplyAmbientVolumes: apply the Interior/Exterior volume and low-pass modifiers |
| `reverb` | boolean | no | Bool for Properties.bReverb (Send to Master Reverb Submix): send referencing sounds to the reverb submix |
| `output_target` | string | no | Properties.OutputTarget enum name (Speaker\|Controller\|ControllerFallbackToSpeaker); case-insensitive, ignored if unrecognized. |
| `loading_behavior` | string | no | Properties.LoadingBehavior enum name (Inherited\|RetainOnLoad\|PrimeOnLoad\|LoadOnDemand\|ForceInline); case-insensitive, ignored if unrecognized. |

**Returns:** `{ sound_class_path: string, success: bool, volume: float, pitch: float, low_pass_frequency: float, attenuation_distance_scale: float, lfe_bleed: float, voice_center_channel_volume: float, radio_filter_volume: float, radio_filter_volume_threshold: float, default_2d_reverb_send_amount: float, apply_effects: bool, always_play: bool, is_ui_sound: bool, is_music: bool, center_channel_only: bool, apply_ambient_volumes: bool, reverb: bool, output_target: string, loading_behavior: string, applied_volume: bool, applied_pitch: bool, applied_low_pass_frequency: bool, applied_attenuation_distance_scale: bool, applied_lfe_bleed: bool, applied_voice_center_channel_volume: bool, applied_radio_filter_volume: bool, applied_radio_filter_volume_threshold: bool, applied_default_2d_reverb_send_amount: bool, applied_apply_effects: bool, applied_always_play: bool, applied_is_ui_sound: bool, applied_is_music: bool, applied_center_channel_only: bool, applied_apply_ambient_volumes: bool, applied_reverb: bool, applied_output_target: bool, applied_loading_behavior: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_concurrency_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Merge fields into a SoundConcurrency asset's Concurrency settings (maxCount, resolutionRule, volume scaling...; absent keys kept), clamp to ClampMin/ClampMax and save; set_properties neither clamps nor saves. Keys match field names case-insensitively. An empty settings object, a key that names no field (the error lists them), a null value, or a value that is not of the field's kind or does not convert is an error and nothing changes. A failed save makes success false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `concurrency_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundConcurrency. |
| `settings` | object | yes | Object of FSoundConcurrencySettings fields to merge (maxCount(int>=1), bLimitToOwner(bool), resolutionRule(enum name), retriggerTime, volumeScale(0..1), volumeScaleMode(enum), bVolumeScaleCanRelease, volumeScaleAttackTime, volumeScaleReleaseTime, voiceStealReleaseTime); absent keys untouched. Keys match the field names case-insensitively; an empty object, a key that names no field, a null value or a value that does not convert is an error and nothing is changed. |

**Returns:** `{ concurrency_path: string, asset_class: string, settings: object, applied_keys: [string], saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_cue_first_node`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Make the node at node_id the root (FirstNode, the output) of a USoundCue graph, undoably, and save the asset. Returns first_node_class, first_node_set and saved; an out-of-range node_id is an error. Get node ids from add_sound_cue_node or get_sound_cue_graph.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cue_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the cue |
| `node_id` | number | yes | node_id (index in the cue AllNodes array) to use as the root of the cue graph |

**Returns:** `{ cue_path: string, node_id: int, first_node_class: string, first_node_set: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_cue_node_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set EditAnywhere properties of one Sound Cue node, located by node_id, then refresh the cue's aggregate values and save it -- the writer twin of get_sound_cue_graph. Use it instead of set_properties, which needs the node's object path rather than the node_id that get_sound_cue_graph and add_sound_cue_node report. Partial update (idempotent): only keys present in properties are written, only CPF_Edit props are touched, and applied_keys lists the editable fields matched (ChildNodes/graph wiring are unreachable here -- use connect_sound_cue_nodes). Keys are the camelCase UPROPERTY names get_sound_cue_graph reports under each node's properties (e.g. a Modulator: pitchMin/pitchMax/volumeMin/volumeMax; a Delay: delayMin/delayMax).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cue_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the cue, e.g. /Game/SoundCues/SC_Foo |
| `node_id` | number | yes | node_id (index in AllNodes) from add_sound_cue_node / get_sound_cue_graph. |
| `properties` | object | yes | Object of {camelCaseName: value} to apply to the node. |

**Returns:** `{ cue_path: string, node_id: int, node_class: string, applied_keys: [string], saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_mix_class_override`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets a sound class adjuster override in a USoundMix.  Loads the USoundMix and USoundClass, adds or updates an FSoundClassAdjuster in the mix's SoundClassEffects array, then saves.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound_mix_path` | string | yes | Content path of the USoundMix asset. |
| `sound_class_path` | string | yes | Content path of the USoundClass to adjust. |
| `volume_adjuster` | number | no | Adjuster.VolumeAdjuster (default 1.0). |
| `pitch_adjuster` | number | no | Adjuster.PitchAdjuster (default 1.0). |
| `apply_to_children` | boolean | no | Adjuster.bApplyToChildren (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ sound_mix_path: string, sound_class_path: string, success: bool, volume_adjuster: float, pitch_adjuster: float, apply_to_children: bool, total_adjusters: int, saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_source_bus_audio_bus`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Point the AudioBus output of a USoundSourceBus asset at a UAudioBus, or clear it when audio_bus_path is empty or omitted, then save; success requires the save. Returns audio_bus_path and audio_bus_class read back, plus cleared. A bus path that does not load is an error, not a clear.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ssb_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USoundSourceBus, e.g. "/Game/Audio/SSB_Radio". |
| `audio_bus_path` | string | no | Asset path of the UAudioBus to assign, e.g. "/Game/Audio/AB_Music"; "" or omitted clears the assignment. |

**Returns:** `{ ssb_path: string, audio_bus_path: string, audio_bus_class: string, cleared: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_source_bus_send_info`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Author a single FSoundSourceBusSendInfo entry on USoundBase::BusSends via reflection (partial merge + clamp).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ssb_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundSourceBus (USoundBase.BusSends is the target array; USoundSourceBus inherits it unchanged). |
| `send_index` | number | yes | 0-based index into BusSends; the entry is REPLACED in place. If out of range, the entry is appended (resize+append). |
| `send_info` | object | yes | Object of FSoundSourceBusSendInfo fields to merge (sourceBusSendLevelControlMethod(Linear\|CustomCurve\|Manual), soundSourceBus(path), audioBus(path), sendLevel(Manual), minSendLevel/maxSendLevel(Linear), minSendDistance/maxSendDistance(Linear), customSendLevelCurve(object), bEnableLPFCutoff(bool), lPFCutoff(20..20000Hz), bEnableHPFCutoff(bool), hPFCutoff(20..20000Hz)). |

**Returns:** `{ ssb_path: string, send_index: int, bus_sends_count: int, send_info: object, applied_keys: [string], saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_source_bus_send_level_curve`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Merge a FRuntimeFloatCurve JSON into BusSends[send_index].CustomSendLevelCurve of a USoundSourceBus asset (BusSends grows with default entries past its end) and save it; success requires the save. Returns the curve read back. The curve only takes effect when that send uses the CustomCurve control method: see set_sound_source_bus_send_info.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ssb_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundSourceBus (USoundBase.BusSends is the target array). |
| `send_index` | number | yes | 0-based index into BusSends; the entry is mutated in place. Resized/extended with default-constructed entries if out of range. |
| `distance_curve` | object | yes | FRuntimeFloatCurve fields by their UPROPERTY names, e.g. {"EditorCurveData": {"Keys": [{"Time": 0.0, "Value": 1.0}, {"Time": 1.0, "Value": 0.0}]}}; Time 0-1 maps to MinSendDistance-MaxSendDistance and Keys replaces the key list. Fields left out keep their current values; unknown keys are ignored without error. |

**Returns:** `{ ssb_path: string, send_index: int, bus_sends_count: int, distance_curve: object, applied_keys: [string], saved: bool }`

## `set_sound_wave_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Merge USoundWave/USoundBase fields into a SoundWave asset (absent keys kept), set bLooping via looping, clamp to ClampMin/ClampMax and save; set_properties neither clamps nor saves. Each property whose value changes runs PostEditChangeProperty, as a details-panel edit does: compression settings rebuild the audio and MaxDistance follows AttenuationSettings. Keys match property names case-insensitively. A key that names no property (the error lists them), a deprecated or instanced-subobject one, a null value, a value of the wrong kind or that does not convert, bLooping inside settings, or a looping that is not true or false is an error and nothing changes. A failed save makes success false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound_wave_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundWave (e.g. /Game/Audio/MySound). |
| `settings` | object | no | Object of USoundWave/USoundBase UPROPERTY fields to merge, keyed by property name (matched case-insensitively); absent keys untouched. e.g. CompressionQuality(1..100), SampleRateQuality(Max/High/Medium/Low/Min), SoundGroup(SOUNDGROUP_Default/SOUNDGROUP_Effects/SOUNDGROUP_UI/SOUNDGROUP_Music/SOUNDGROUP_Voice), SoundAssetCompressionType(BinkAudio/ADPCM/PCM/Opus/PlatformSpecific/ProjectDefined), Volume(>=0), Pitch(0.125..4.0), Priority(0..100), VirtualizationMode(Disabled/PlayWhenSilent/Restart/SeekRestart), SoundClassObject(asset path), AttenuationSettings(asset path). A key that names no property, a deprecated one or one holding instanced subobjects, a null value, a value that does not convert, a settings value that is not an object, or `bLooping` (use the `looping` param) is an error and nothing is changed. |
| `looping` | boolean | no | Optional bool; sets the bLooping bitfield directly (when this sound is played directly, not via a cue). A value that is not true or false is an error and nothing is changed. |

**Returns:** `{ sound_wave_path: string, asset_class: string, settings: object, applied_keys: [string], applied_looping: bool, looping: bool, saved: bool, save_error?: string }`

## `set_submix_effect_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Configure a submix effect preset's Settings struct (by chain index) via reflection (partial merge + clamp).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `submix_path` | string | yes | Full content path of the target USoundSubmix |
| `effect_index` | number | yes | 0-based index into SubmixEffectChain (same order add_submix_effect_to_chain appended / get_submix_effect_chain reports) |
| `settings` | object | yes | Object of fields to merge into the preset's Settings struct; absent keys untouched |

**Returns:** `{ submix_path: string, effect_index: int, preset_class: string, settings: object, saved: bool }`

## `set_subtitle_cue`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Updates the text and timing fields on an existing subtitle cue.  Loads the USubtitleAssetUserData, applies any combination of text / start_offset / duration / duration_type to Subtitles[cue_index], and saves. Fields not provided are left untouched.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Content path of the USubtitleAssetUserData asset. |
| `cue_index` | number | yes | Zero-based index into the Subtitles array (required). |
| `text` | string | no | Optional new subtitle text (Subtitles[cue_index].Text); an empty string clears it. |
| `start_offset` | number | no | Optional new StartOffset (seconds). |
| `duration` | number | no | Optional new Duration (seconds). |
| `duration_type` | string | no | Optional new SubtitleDurationType ("use_sound_duration" or "use_duration_property"). |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path: string, cue_index: int, success: bool, applied_text: bool, applied_start_offset: bool, applied_duration: bool, applied_duration_type: bool, text?: string (when text was given, read back), start_offset: float, duration: float, duration_type: string, saved: bool }`

## `stop_sound`

*Destructive.*

Stop playback on an audio component of the editor world (UAudioComponent::Stop), matched by object name against the first audio component of each actor; components in a running PIE world are not reached. Returns was_playing and playing; success is always true. Start playback with play_sound.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio_component_name` | string | yes | Object name of the audio component to stop (e.g. "AudioComponent0"), compared without case; only the first audio component of each actor is searched. |

**Returns:** `{ audio_component_name: string, playing: bool, was_playing: bool, success: bool }`
